acceptanceCriteria: No command, MCP tool, projection, gate or CI job reads or writes cem/0.1, cem/0.2 or cem/0.3; a repository search for those wire strings outside history, build-log and decision records finds only recorded exceptions.
Superseded specs, acceptance criteria and AGENTS.md references are amended in the same change; LICENSING.md path boundaries stay correct.
Focused tests, go vet, the doc gates and the interop/cem01-go module tests pass on go1.27.2; the dogfood loop binds and seals the removal change as cem/1.0.
body: Source: decision 0525 (docs/decisions/0525-cem-1-0-only-rc3-2026-10-11.md, PR beamfall/corvint#819), owner instruction 2026-10-11 that rc.3 ships cem/1.0 as the only CEM. Owner lane: orchestrating session; the CEM 1.0 vision session owns the wire (V1-1262/1273/1263/1264/1265/1266). After the migration run passes, remove every 0.x producer and consumer path: protocol/cem-0.2, protocol/cem-0.3 and interop cem-0.1 packets, the 0.x schemas and specs as governing contracts, 0.x tests, fixtures, goldens (cmd/corvint/testdata/core-freeze), gates, examples, the 0.x paths in interop/cem01-go (the module stays as the portable cem/1.0 consumer), and the converter. The inherited 0.1/0.3 algorithms and CEM-SM-001..010 stay as cem/1.0-normative text re-homed by the wire owner. Supersedes decision 0357's freeze, CEM-CB-025 and the 0.x-preserving criteria of V1-0595/V1-0632, each amended in the same change. If V1-1265 misses rc.3, this ticket stays open and rc.3 reports decision 0525 section 1 as unmet.
title: cem/1.0 decision 0525 step 7: remove cem/0.1, 0.2 and 0.3 from source, protocol packets, specs, tests and gates
